subject: Physics
question: An electric motor lifts a 40 kg load through a height of 12 m in 8.0 s. The electrical power input to the motor is 750 W. Calculate the useful power output and the efficiency of the motor. Take g = 9.81 m s⁻².
response_text:
Useful work done: W = mgh = 40 × 9.8 × 12 = 4704 J ≈ 4.7 kJ
Useful power output: P_out = W/t = 4704 / 8.0 = 588 W ≈ 0.59 kW
Efficiency = P_out / P_in × 100% = 588 / 750 × 100% = 78.4% ≈ 78%

(I used g ≈ 9.8 m s⁻² here; with 9.81 m s⁻² the output is 589 W and the efficiency still rounds to 78%.)

correct_steps: with 9.81 m s⁻² the output is 589 W and the efficiency still rounds to 78%
